data.one_liner: Solid Lints provides a comprehensive set of Dart and Flutter lint rules based on industry standards.
data.what_it_does: It configures the analyzer with a curated set of lint rules to enforce code quality and best practices. The package includes rules for production code and a separate set for test code.
use_when: You want stricter static analysis for a Dart or Flutter project
You need a single source of truth for lint rules across teams
You want to enforce industry‑standard coding guidelines
avoid_when: You already use another linter configuration that covers all required rules
You prefer minimal linting and want to avoid the additional rule set
strengths: Broad rule set covering many common issues
Regular updates with new rules and bug fixes
weaknesses: May introduce new lint errors on upgrade
Requires updating analysis_options.yaml and plugin version
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies, include analysis_options.yaml and plugin entry in analysis_options.yaml

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter linter with a smaller rule set

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: General Dart linter with a moderate rule set

data.minimal_example:
```yaml
dev_dependencies:
  solid_lints: ^2.0.0

analysis_options:
  include: package:solid_lints/analysis_options.yaml
  plugins:
    solid_lints: ^2.0.0
```
